undeclared.decision: Annotation queues use deterministic hash ordering within each game/task/split group and round-robin sampling across groups.

undeclared.decision: Each pair selects one review passage with the most shared retrieval terms; ties select the earliest passage. Full review text is also retained.
undeclared.why_it_matters: This determines the default passage presented to downstream models. P19 declares preservation of passages and context but not this selection rule.

undeclared.decision: Announcements classified as promotion or event are excluded from change extraction entirely.
undeclared.why_it_matters: Mixed announcements containing substantive changes produce no change candidates when assigned either type. P08 does not declare this population exclusion.

undeclared.decision: supervised_training_ready becomes true when at least one accepted training pair exists.
